architecture: One Knowledge Graph · Two Learning Paths
purpose: Reconcile the 35 unresolved historical Grade-6 KNTT skill references against the current canonical skill/family universe without inflating the taxonomy or changing learner runtime.

resolution_definitions.CANONICAL_SKILL: Historical ref can map to an existing canonical diagnostic skill. Many-to-one mapping is allowed when current taxonomy intentionally uses broader granularity.
resolution_definitions.CANONICAL_FAMILY: The concept belongs in an existing family, but should remain lesson-local/problem-type/representation granularity rather than becoming a new global assessed skill.
resolution_definitions.LESSON_LOCAL: The concept is confirmed Core/lesson content but remains a lesson-local application technique/problem type rather than a global assessed-skill identity.

summary.note: All 35 Grade-6 historical refs are semantically reconciled. The raw exact-ID mismatch count remains preserved in the Coverage Matrix for traceability.
